content.title: OLED Q3 Deep Dive: Capacity Expansion and Blue OLED Progress Shape Outlook
content.summary: OLED provider Universal Display (NASDAQ:OLED) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 13.6% year on year to $139.6 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $675 million at the midpoint. Its GAAP profit of $0.92 per share was 21.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
